entry_state: Regional and entity disclosures preserve unresolved allocations, ownership paths, currencies and tax identities. Legal proceedings distinguish allegations, findings, proposed remedies and financial consequences. The next section introduces later disclosure changes without rewriting earlier information.
exit_state: Later disclosures add source-specific detail without rewriting earlier availability. Indemnities, insurance, regulation, demand, supply and recovery are distinct causal channels with dated contracts and assumptions; the next operating discussion must preserve those distinctions through product transitions.
findings: Later comparative regional expenses reconcile to the same earlier operating income while retaining different labels and source identities. Exact-version availability remains unverified rather than inferred from filing metadata.
Indemnification direction, defense costs, settlement effects and insurance recovery remain separate. Repeated risk wording does not establish unchanged contracts or a numerical insured share.

Regulatory constraints, weaker demand, unavailable components and recovery spending require different events and dates. The hypothetical histories supply mechanisms without estimated probabilities or universal financial haircuts. No new confirmed defect.
